steps.text:
I've built the audience-vote graphic. It validated with no errors or warnings and is recorded in `/mnt/session/outputs/record.json`, with `record.zip` next to it. Nothing was saved to the NoaCG library.

**How it looks:** a dark panel along the bottom of the frame, inside the title-safe margins. When the vote is on air the panel takes up the bottom quarter of the frame, so the presenter has the upper part to themselves. On the left is a red dot with the kicker "AUDIENCE VOTE" and the question in large bold type. On the right, each option has its own row: the answer, a bar and the percentage.

**The leading option:** the graphic works out which option is ahead every time the numbers change. That row gets a gold bar with a soft glow, a gold percentage and a bold white label. The other rows are grey and dimmed. If two options tie for the lead, both are marked.

**Live updates:** when the operator presses Update, the bars slide to their new lengths instead of jumping, so viewers can see the vote shift. Typing a plain number like `46` shows as `46%`.

**What the operator gets:**

| Input | Live or set once |
|---|---|
| Options: one line per answer, written `Answer \| %`. Add or remove ...
